description: This file defines an abstract Data Access Object (DAO) class for interacting with Cassandra NoSQL database, including methods for preparing statements, executing read/write operations asynchronously and synchronously, and managing Cassandra sessions and consistency levels.

classes.name: CassandraAbstractDao
classes.description: An abstract class providing common Cassandra database operations such as preparing statements, executing read/write queries asynchronously and synchronously, and managing session and consistency levels.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the Cassandra session, setting default consistency levels.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares a CQL query statement and caches it.

methods.name: executeRead
methods.description: Executes a read statement synchronously with default read consistency level.

methods.name: executeWrite
methods.description: Executes a write statement synchronously with default write consistency level.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Internal method to execute a statement synchronously with specified consistency level.

methods.name: executeAsync
methods.description: Internal method to execute a statement asynchronously with specified consistency level.

methods.name: statementToString
methods.description: Converts a Statement object to its string representation for logging.
